record.body:
## Orientation

Territory: wave-2 parallel with oracle-freeze-close. You own ONLY: skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md, skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md, skills/verify-work/SKILL.md (discuss only if freeze examples require it), and tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py / test_plan_trace.py updates. Do NOT edit close_batch or check.py.

Worktree: /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses. Do not write .artifacts/. Do not call adaptive-artifacts.

Concurrency: sibling may commit in the same worktree. Before git commit:
  flock /tmp/oracle-witnesses-git.lock -c 'git -C /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses add -A -- . ":!.artifacts" && git -C /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses commit -m "oracle-skills"'

Contract already has test_ids, oracle_hashes, oracle-amendment — examples must be legal under that contract.

All oracle-skills* acceptances must pass.

## Requirements (R1, R4, R6, R7)

R1: plan-phase one phase-scoped oracle-author subagent from requirement/spec text only.
R4: contract oracle-amendment; executor must not edit frozen oracle files; parent approves.
R6: mechanical oracle verify when assertion red at base, green at head, hashes match or approved amendment.
R7: skills and tests document/lock R1–R6; skill↔contract consistency green.

## Design Invariants

- Oracle author ≠ executor for oracle-backed tdd.
- Frozen hashes are the close authority for oracle file contents; agent prose is not.
- Assertion-level red is required before freeze and before done close.
- Parent session alone writes freeze fields, amendments, and assessments.

## Design Assumptions

- Pytest emits assertion failures detectably.
- One phase-scoped oracle author can cover multiple requirements.
- Existing red-first ancestry rules remain.

## Decisions

- oracle-author-grain: one oracle-author subagent per phase
- oracle-loop-shape: full oracle loop
- amendment-approver: parent session approves
